title: 演化混合LoRA架构的分解：路由杠杆、生命周期惩罚与基板条件边界
summary: 对约1.5亿参数的演化混合LoRA系统进行分解，发现路由重写带来显著改进（+0.0426 nats），而生命周期机制反而造成性能拖累（约-0.028 nats）。通过可控合成沙盒定位了基板条件边界：演化搜索仅在适配器预对齐任务时有效。
summary_en: Decomposes an evolutionary mixture-of-LoRA system, finding the router rewrite yields significant improvement (+0.0426 nats) while the lifecycle mechanism is a net drag (~-0.028 nats). A synthetic sandbox reveals a substrate-conditional boundary: evolutionary search is load-bearing only when adapters are pre-aligned to the task.
